caption: A wedge is driven into a log using a sledgehammer, splitting the log cleanly apart.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A wedge is driven into a log using a sledgehammer, splitting the log cleanly apart. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The log must be positioned horizontally and stable on the ground for the wedge to be driven into it.
The wedge must be inserted at an angle into the log to create a split.
The sledgehammer must be used to strike the wedge repeatedly to deepen the split.
The log must be split cleanly apart as the wedge is driven further in.
